Definition: a primary verb (in a strengthened form); to scent (usually an ill "odor"):--stink.
BiblicalUsage: To stink appears once, at the tomb of Lazarus, when Martha said to Jesus, Lord, by this time he stinketh, for he hath been dead four days, and Jesus answered that if she believed she would see the glory of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Martha's plain words are the honest cry of grief: by this time he stinketh — and Jesus raised him anyway.
